messages:
incident-bot: P1 page triggered: `apac-streaming-tokenizer` high tail latency and 5xx for streaming completions in ap-southeast-1. Auto-pager: maya (oncall) · severity: P1 · runbook: tokenization-fallback · bridge: #oncall-bridge

maya (oncall): I’m on it. Joining bridge now. Can someone grab quick customer-impact numbers?

samir (platform): On the bridge. Early signal looks like tokenizer microservice GC spikes + new tokenization model rollout at 02:10 UTC. Heap growth, slow iterator. Logs: `toksvc:GC pause 1500ms` repeated.

ops-bot: Detected 67% increase in streaming tail latency (p99) and ~4% 5xx rate for streaming endpoints in ap-southeast-1 over the last 5m.

maya (oncall): Mitigation plan: roll traffic to legacy-tokenizer and disable new tokenizer model. Samir, can you flip routing?

samir (platform): Yeah. Plan A: enable legacy route via feature flag service `token-router` and scale legacy pool x2. Commands:
```
# enable legacy routing for ap-southeast-1
curl -X POST "https://controlplane/api/flags/token-router" -d '{"region":"ap-southeast-1","mode":"legacy"}'
./infractl scale pool legacy-tokenizer --region ap-southeast-1 --replicas 2
```
I’ll kick those now. Rolling in 1..3..

samir (platform): Done. Flag set, scaled legacy pool. Routing shows ~60% traffic to legacy within 90s. p99 latency dropping in metrics.

emily (support): Noted. Any customers definitely impacted yet? I have two open tickets from APAC trial users complaining about streaming stalls.

jordan (comms): Draft status page copy (initial). Please thumbs if OK: 
"We are investigating increased latency and errors affecting streaming responses for customers in APAC. Mitigation is in progress; updates will be posted every 15 minutes. Impact: intermittent streaming stalls and 5xx errors for a subset of requests. Services affected: text-generation streaming endpoints."

nina (legal): Please add: "No customer data exfiltration is suspected at this time." and avoid absolutes like "resolved" until we confirm.

lex (product): Add note to mention Dedicated/Private customers: some Private deployments on-prem also show the same tokenizer model version; ops runbook for private customers executed?

maya (oncall): Quick check on private customers: Samir, can we push advisory to Private instances or at least list impacted versions?

samir (platform): We can push config override for customers on `tok-model:v3.2` but not autopush to air-gapped. I’ll list affected versions in the status copy.

jordan (comms): Updated draft: "We are investigating increased latency and errors affecting streaming responses for customers in APAC. Mitigation: routing to a legacy tokenizer and scaling fallback pools is in progress. Affected versions include tok-model:v3.2. Private/on-prem customers with v3.2 may experience similar behavior; contact support for targeted assistance. No customer data exfiltration is suspected at this time. Updates every 15 minutes."

emily (support): OK. I’ll push to the support queue and tag known accounts on v3.2.

ops-bot: Metric update: p99 latency in ap-southeast-1 decreased from 4.2s to 1.1s after routing change. 5xx rate down from 4% -> 0.6% in last 3m.

maya (oncall): Good trend. Let’s hold for two update cycles before publishing a 'resolved' status. Next update in ~12 minutes. Also creating incident channel #inc-apac-tokenizer-1764301234 for follow-ups.

samir (platform): Action items: collect GC heap dumps from failing instances, snapshot tok-model:v3.2 container image, and throttle rollout in other regions. I’ve paused the v3.2 rollout to other regions.

jordan (comms): Next status update (15m): 
"Update: We have routed traffic to a legacy tokenizer and scaled fallback capacity. Error rates and p99 latency are improving. We're continuing to monitor and collect logs for root cause analysis. Estimated next update: in 15 minutes."

nina (legal): approved wording. Add request to hold any customer-facing blame on vendor/model until RCA.

lex (product): Also add: "If you see persistent problems after this update, please include request IDs and approximate timestamps when contacting support."

emily (support): Noted, I’ll ask agents to request request IDs. Also preparing a canned support message to paste into tickets.

ops-bot: 2nd metric snapshot: continued improvement. All green for core streaming routes in ap-southeast-1. Occasional single-request 5xx spikes remain (~0.1%).

maya (oncall): Given stable metrics, I want a short internal post before we mark resolved. Jordan, prepare resolved copy + internal summary. Samir, keep GC dumps + container image pulled for postmortem.

jordan (comms): Resolved draft: 
"Resolved: The APAC streaming latency and error spike has been mitigated by routing traffic to a legacy tokenizer and scaling fallback capacity. Error rates and tail latency have returned to normal for affected customers. We are investigating the root cause and will publish an RCA when available. If you continue to experience issues, please contact support with request IDs and timestamps."

nina (legal): Resolved copy OK. Please do not commit to a timeline for RCA.

emily (support): I’ll send resolved update to open tickets and mark impacted customers.

samir (platform): Collected heap dumps and images pushed to the incident bucket `s3://incidents/1764301234/`. Starting in-depth analysis and scheduling a postmortem tomorrow.

maya (oncall): Publishing initial + update + resolved on status page now. Will also pin this thread and hand off to Samir for RCA; I’ll close oncall after 30m of stable metrics. Good work team :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Statuspage publish events: initial -> update -> resolved posted. Links: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1764301234 (internal short link)

jordan (comms): Confirmed published. I pushed tweet and customer email for known affected beta accounts.

maya (oncall): Closing bridge. Samir, file a postmortem ticket and add action items: better canary gating for tokenizer model, improved GC flags, and faster rollback path.

samir (platform): Will do. Filing PM ticket and inviting product + infra.

ops-bot: Incident closed by maya (oncall) — duration ~42m.

maya (oncall): Thanks all. Follow-up: we’ll sync RCA tomorrow 1600 UTC.
